title: 毎日王冠の後に・でけえ背中

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The victor of the Mainichi Okan is Oguri Cap. Inari One becomes panicked with the thought that she might not make it as Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, she overhears the fans talking and realizes her performance wasn't enough to prove the might of the Oi racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal race, the autumn Tenno Sho, is right around the corner, but Inari One grows increasingly flustered as her goals seem to slip further away from her grasp.
